thread:
Maya: Heads-up — p99 for the continuous batcher shot up in us-west-2 ~03:14 UTC, throughput dipped on a handful of nodes. p95 went from ~120ms to ~420ms. Anyone seeing something similar?
Jon: yep seeing same on infra dashboards, looks localized to node pool gpu-pool-6.
Cheng: correlating with a flurry of KV cache replays — a shard got saturated and started evicting prefixes, then we got a replay storm.
Maya: any recent changes to kernel selector or admission heuristics?
Anita: rolled a scheduler tweak this morning that changes token-bucket refill windows for admission (PR #4892). It was canaried but then promoted.
Lucas: found logs from one affected pod — kernel selector flipped to fallback kernel under pressure. Snippet: ```kernel_selector: chosen=matmul_fast_v3 fallback=matmul_ref reason=kv_cache_miss_rate>0.6```
Jon: that fallback is ~3-4x slower on long-seq workloads, would explain tail. Also microbatch sizes condensed -> more small microbatches = higher overhead.
Cheng: perf-bot traces show high syscalls around the same time (KV eviction loop thrash). Attached trace link: https://perf.redwood/internal/trace/0x7a9c (private)
perf-bot: automated profiler summary: p50 28ms p95 130ms p99 410ms cpu% on kernel matmul_ref increased 320% for impacted tasks.
Maya: can we throttle replays at admission? Maybe stop admission for requests that trigger big prefix misses until KV warms?
Anita: immediate mitigation — I can revert the refill-window change for the promoted rollout. Want me to flip it back to old behavior?
Lucas: 👍 do it. Also add a temporary kill-switch to force kernel selection to prefer stable matmul_fast_v2 for canary-sized batches.
Jon: reverted scheduler PR on canary and started a rolling rollback to the affected pool. Running watch: `kubectl -n inference rollout restart ds/gpu-pool-6`
Cheng: after rollback p99 is coming down — current p99 ~150ms and trending. Looks like admission tweak combined with KV eviction spike + kernel fallback created the cascade.
Maya: great. Next: postmortem + follow-up items: (1) add guardrail in kernel-selector to avoid fallback for short microbatches, (2) change admission to backoff replays, (3) add alert for kv_cache_replay_rate > 0.1 sustained.
Anita: filing follow-up tickets and will pin a canary test that simulates KV eviction bursts. Will also open a patch to make refill-window change feature-flagged.
Lucas: note for the perf PR — include microbatch histograms (counts of batch sizes) in canary smoke so we catch condensation effects.
Maya: thanks all. Marking resolved for now, will track postmortem. :white_check_mark:
__notes: This document is a Slack thread; messages are short and chronological. No title field included per agents.md rules.
